Hi Nadia,

You can get the visiting contractor connected through guest Wi-Fi:

1. Sponsor the guest at wifi.homefixsupply.com/guest.
2. Have her join the “HomeFix-Guest” network and use the code she receives.
3. Guest access provides internet access only and does not include internal HomeFix resources.

The standard guest code is valid for 24 hours, but access can be extended to 5 days for auditors and contractors by any people-manager, so it can cover her four-day visit.

Best,
HomeFix Supply Support Team

Hi Laura,

You can get your final payslips through the former employee portal rather than your disabled network account.

1. Go to alumni.homefixsupply.com.
2. Sign in using the personal email address you registered before leaving HomeFix.
3. Open My Documents to find your payslips.

Former employees keep payslip access for 24 months. Please note that the IT Service Desk cannot see or change payroll data; payroll corrections go through your HR business partner.

Best regards,
HomeFix Supply Support Team
